book.name: Yohana
book.title: Malobhi Manyahi ngati moghalembakike na Yohana

content: Yesu na mbomba Msamalia
Mafalisayo bhakajowini kubha Yesu abhapata bhabhulwa bhamaheli kupeta Yohana, na kubhabatiza bhandu.
Nambu nga Yesu mweni joakabhi abatiza bhandu, nambu bhabhulwa bhaki,
Bhela Yesu paakajowini mambu ghanihagha akabhokiki ku inchi ja Yudea, na akakelawiki kabheti mbaka ku Galilaya.
Pamwanja ghonihoghu ikampaliki kupeta ku muchi wa Samalia.
Bhela akahikiki ku muchi wa ku Samalia, ghoulowakeka Sikali, pambipi na ngonda ghola Yakobo ghoakumpeki Yusufu mwana waki.
Na panihapa pakabhi na chilibha chaka Yakobo. Bhela Yesu, kwa ndandi akatondiki na mwanja waki, akatami pambipi na pachilibha pala. Kukabhi ngati saa sita ja muhi.
Bhela akahikiki mbomba Msamalia kuteka machi. Yesu akumpwaghile, “Mbekya machi ngunywaje.”
Kwa ndandi chikahi hechi bhabhulwa bhaka Yesu bhakapiti kumbwani kuheme chilebhe.

Bhela mbomba Msamalia jola akumpwaghi Yesu, “Bho, kubhi bholi wehapa wa Myahude kupala machi kwangu nepani, koni nepani nu mbomba Msamalia?” Maghambu Bhayahude ngachebhajongana na Bhasamalia hata pachokope.

Yesu akamuyangiki, na kumpwaghila, “Ngati ukamanyiki chindu chela Chapanga cheapala kukupekeha, najombi nde nane joakupwaghila, ‘Mbekya machi ngunywaje,’ ukabya unjopiki jombi, najombi akabya akupekihi machi ghaghabhi ghomi.”
Mbomba jola akumpwaghile, “Bambo, ngacheubhi na chindu cha kutekela machi, na chilibha nde chilachu. Bho, ughapatiki kwaku machi ghanihagha ghaghabhi ghomi?
Bho, wehapa ubhi unkolongwa kupeta tati witu Yakobo, joakatupeki chilibha chenu, najombi akanywili machi ghaki, na bhana bhaki, na hinyama yaki?”
Yesu akamuyangiki, na kumpwaghila, “Kila joakunywa machi aghagha anaabhona nywita kabhete.
Nambu mundu jokapi joanakunywa machi ghala ghaananumpekya nepani ngaibhoni inywita mileli. Nambu machi ghala ghaananupekya anaghabya chemichemi ja machi mkati jaki, ghakajitikaje womi wa mileli.”
Mbomba jola akapwaghike, “Bambo, umbekya machi ghanihagha, nganibhona inywita kabhete, wala nganihika kabhete pambane kuteka machi.”
Yesu akumpwaghile, “Jendaje ukundoha ndomi waku, na uhika naku pambane.”
Mbomba jola akamuyangiki, na kupwagha, “Ngachemili na ndomi wangu.” Yesu akumpwaghile, “Uyangiki wichu, ngacheubhi na ndomi waku.
Kwa ndandi ubhi na akanalomi nhwanu, na mwanalomi joubhi naku sajenu nga ndomi wako, panihapa upwaghiki chakaka.”
Mbomba jola akumpwaghile, “Bambo, mona kubha wehepa wa mlota waka Chapanga.
Akahoko bhitu bhakabhi bhajojabhela pa chitombi achechi, nanamu mpwagha kubha ku Yelusalemu nde pandu pa chakaka pa kunjojabhela Chapanga.”
Yesu akumpwaghile, “Mbomba, unhobhalyaje chembwagha, machobha ghahika ambapu ngamwanjojabheli Atati pa chitombi achechi, wala ku Yelusalemu.
Mwenga Bhasamalia mkijojabhela changa kuchimanya, nambu tepani tujojabhela chetukimanya, maghambu ukengaleku uhuma kwa Bhayahude.
Nambu chikahi chihika, na chombi chihikike, ambapu bhajojabhela bha chakaka anabhunjojabya Atati mu Roho Mhuhu na mu chakaka. Kwa ndandi Atati abhalonda bhandu ngati bhanihaba bhunjojabyaje.
Chapanga nde Roho, na bhombi bhabhunjojabhe jombi ibhapalika kunjojabhela mu Roho Mhuhu na mu chakaka.”
Mbomba jola akumpwaghile, “Manyi kubha anahika Masihi, joalowakeka Kristo, najombi paanahikaje, jombi anaatuhyekulyaje mambu ghokapi.”
Yesu akamuyangike, “Nepani nenongela na wehapa, nde Masihi.”
Panihapa bhakahikiki bhabhulwa bhaki, bhakakangichi ndandi Yesu akabhi alongela na mbomba, nambu njeta hata jumu joakapwaghike, “Bho, ulonda kike?” Au, kundalukila, “Bho, mbona ulongela na mbomba?”
Bhela mbomba jola akachilekiki chihulu chaki, na kujenda kumbwane, na kubhapwaghi bhandu,
“Muhikaje, mumbona mundu joambwaghi mambu ghokapi ghanhengike. Bho, iwezekana le kubha hajoju nde Kristo?”
Bhela bhandu bhakahumiki kumbwani, na bhakunjendili Yesu.
Kunyuma kola bhabhulwa bhakabhi bhundobha, bhakapwaghaje, “Mbola, ukula chilebhe!”
Yesu akabhapwaghile, “Nepani mi na chilebhe changa kuchimanya mwehapa.”
Bhela bhabhulwa bhaka Yesu bhakapwaghanile, “Bho, kubhi na mundu joandeti chilebhe?”
Yesu akabhapwaghile, “Chilebhi changu nde achechi, naghatendaje mapalu ghaki jola joandumike, na kujomola lihengu laki.

Bho, mwehapa ngachempwagha, ‘Jikona myehi nchechi, nde paghihika mahunu?’ Lingalyaje, nepani numpwaghila, nkwehaje mihu ghinu mujilingalya mighonda, kubha chilebhi mungonda chijomwi kukoma, na chibhi tayali kwa mahunu.
Na jombi joahuna ajopalela malepu ghaki, na kubhongana mahunu kwa ndandi ja womi wa mileli, nahuli jola joapanda na jola joahuna bhapata kuhekalela papamu.
Kwa ndandi panihapa lilobhi leniheli likubha chakaka kubha, ‘Jumu apanda, na jongi kuhuna.’
Nenga nakuntumiki mughahuna ghala ghanga kughahangajakila, bhangi bhakahengiki lihengu lelinonwipe, nanamu mpatiki nyonjeka kubhokana na lihengu labhu lelinonwipe.”
Na ku muchi wa Bhasamalia ghola bhandu bhamaheli bhakunhobhali Yesu kwa ndandi ja kulandila kwaka mbomba jola, joakalandili kubha, “Akambwaghi mambu ghokapi ghanakahengike.”
Bhela Bhasamalia bhala pabhakunjendi Yesu, bhakundobhiki atama kwabhu, najombi akatami konikola machobha ghabhele.
Bhandu bhamaheli nakanopi bhakahobhalili kwa ndandi ja malobhi ghaka Yesu.
Bhakumpwaghi mbomba jola, “Henu tuhobhalela, wala nga kwa ndandi ja malobhi ghaku pela, maghambu tepani tujowini tabhete, na tumanyi kubha chakaka hajoju nde Kristo, Mkengalela wa ndema.”
Yesu andamiha mwana waka Ofisa
Bhela paghapetiki machobha ghabheli hagha Yesu akabhokiki konihoku, na kujenda ku Galilaya.
Kwa ndandi Yesu mweni akapwaghiki, “Mlota waka Chapanga ngacheapata utopelu mu inchi jaki mwene.”

Bhela paakahikiki ku Galilaya, Bhagalilaya bhakunjopalili, kwa ndandi bhanganya habha na bhombi bhakapiti ku uwangalalu wa Pasaka, na bhakaghaweni mambu ghokapi Yesu ghaakahengiki ku Yelusalemu kola chikahi cha uwangalalu hoghu.
Bhela akahikiki kabheti ku Kana ja Galilaya, panihapa paakaghatendiki machi kubha divai. Panihapa pakabhi na ofisa jumu joakabhi na mwana waki mtamwa ku Kapelenaumu hoku.
Jombi paakajowini kubha Yesu ahikiki kuhuma ku Yudea mbaka ku Galilaya, akunjendili, akundobhiki ahelalaje na ajendaje kundamiha mwana waki joakabhi mtamwa, kwa ndandi akabhi pambipi kupotela.
Bhela Yesu akumpwaghile, “Nanga kubhona nginyulila na ngangachu, ngamwihobhaleli ng'o.”
Ofisa jola akumpwaghile, “Bambo, chondi uhelalaje mangani mwana wangu ngacheapotile.”
Yesu akumpwaghile, “Ujendaje, mwana waku alamike.” Mundu jola akalihobhali lilobhi lela leakalongi Yesu, najombi akapiti.
Na paakabhi ahelela, bhatumika bhaki bhakunjopalile, bhakapwaghaje, “Mwana waku alamike!”
Bhela akabhalalukili lisaa paakatumbwi kubha wichu, na bhombi bhakumpwaghili, “Lichu, saa saba ja muhi, chitamu chakundekike.”
Bhela tati waki akamanyiki kubha lisaa lelalela leakumpwaghi Yesu, “Mwana waku alamike.” Jombi na bhokapi bha munyumba jaki bhakunhobhali Yesu.
Jeniheji nde nginyulila ja kabheli jeakahengiki Yesu, paakabhi ahuma ku Yudea kujenda ku Galilaya.
